Become part of something bigger. Work with more than 2000 specialists from more than 100 professions and enable paraplegic people to live a self-determined life. On the modern campus in Nottwil, an inspiring atmosphere and interdisciplinary cooperation at eye level awaits you.

Formed education. Develop people. Move the future. Do you want to take the next step and take responsibility? As an education manager, you are part of the management team on the station and are heartily committed to education in the department. Tasks: • You guide and accompany trainees (AGS, FaGe, care HF and FH) appreciatively, clearly and initiate targeted support in problem and crisis situations • You implement the concept of vocational training care in the department, plan the trainees according to the training course, write qualifications and work with doctoral elements (IPA and expert discussions) as an exam expert • You are the contact person for education-specific questions for the management team, care team and the interprofessional team • You recognize the educational needs in the nursing team of the department and initiate appropriate measures • You take on joint responsibility for personnel planning, organization and administrative processes in the department and work in direct care • You bring in ideas, work in projects and are jointly responsible for an innovative and attractive further development of training in nursing SPZ Requirements • Diploma as nursing specialist HF/FH • Care professional experience • Delight in educational tasks or a clear desire to develop into them • Communication strength, flexibility and organisational skills • Courage to question the existing and try new things We offer: You not only expect attractive employment conditions, but also numerous other advantages. Look forward to meaningful work in a modern working environment, flexible working hours and a wide range of further education opportunities. Come and experience our unique spirit. More information on parplegie.ch/benefits. The Swiss Paraplegic Centre in Nottwil is a private, nationally and internationally recognized specialist clinic for cross-sectional, back and respiratory medicine. As an acute and rehabilitation clinic, the centre offers its patients comprehensive care and supports them throughout their lives. The clinic is part of the Swiss Paraplegic Group, which provides a globally unique service network for the holistic rehabilitation of people with paraplegia.

Venez vivre notre esprit unique. Plus d'informations sur parplegie.ch/bénéfices. Le Centre suisse des paraplégiques de Nottwil est une clinique spécialisée privée, reconnue au niveau national et international pour la médecine transversale, du dos et respiratoire. La clinique fait partie du Groupe suisse des paraplégiques, qui fournit un réseau de services unique au monde pour la réadaptation holistique des personnes atteintes de paraplégie.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Diventa parte di qualcosa di più grande. Collabora con oltre 2.000 specialisti provenienti da più di 100 professioni e consenti alle persone con paraplegia di condurre una vita autodeterminata. Un'atmosfera stimolante e una collaborazione interdisciplinare ad altezza d'occhio ti aspettano nel moderno campus di Nottwil. La medicina dello sport dell'SPZ si prende cura di tutti gli appassionati di sport, siano essi atleti su sedia a rotelle o pedoni, atleti di punta, atleti amatoriali ambiziosi o principianti. Siamo il National Performance Center (NLZ) per gli sport su sedia a rotelle e accompagniamo i nostri atleti dalle sedie a rotelle di base agli sport d'élite, dalle competizioni regionali alle Paralimpiadi. Come Swiss Olympic Medical Center siamo un punto di riferimento per gli atleti Swiss Olympic. Offriamo visite mediche sportive, analisi delle prestazioni e sviluppo dell'allenamento, consulenza sull'alimentazione sportiva, nonché fisioterapia sportiva e psicologia dello sport, compresa la ricerca di accompagnamento su argomenti legati allo sport. Compiti:
• Elaborazione e realizzazione di programmi di allenamento personalizzati "guidati dall'evidenza" in collaborazione con gli esperti della NLZ
• Collaborazione interdisciplinare nel team di esperti della NLZ (scienza dello sport, alimentazione, psicologia e medicina)
• Supervisione degli atleti paralimpici nelle unità di atletica
• Creazione dell'interfaccia tra gli atleti paralimpici e i loro allenatori, nonché tra la NLZ e gli esperti di prestazione
• Impiego nell'ambito delle RS sportive di punta della massima promozione sportiva dell'Esercito svizzero e, se necessario, nei campi di allenamento
• Supporto durante le prestazioni procedure di test diagnostici in laboratorio e sul campo Requisiti:
• Esperienza come allenatore con atleti di alto livello abbinata alla formazione di allenatori professionisti
• Studi in scienze dello sport o del movimento o formazione in fisioterapia sportiva
• Pensiero olistico per quanto riguarda la promozione dello sport di alto livello
• Elevate capacità di comunicazione e grande flessibilità

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il dolore neuropatico è una condizione di salute secondaria grave e debilitante dopo la lesione del midollo spinale (SCI). Probabilmente comporta interazioni cerebrali-spinali anormali, tra cui ipereccitabilità spinale e modulazione del dolore alterata nel cervello, ma le prove negli esseri umani sono ancora mancanti a causa della mancanza di protocolli di imaging per misurare l'attività del midollo spinale. In questo studio multicentro (Swiss Paraplegic Research / Balgrist University Hospital), studieremo il dolore neuropatico in SCI utilizzando cervello e midollo spinale fMRI. Dopo aver istituito e convalidato un nuovo protocollo fMRI del cavo lumbosacrale attraverso i due centri, valuteremo la sensibilizzazione spinale e l'attività cerebrale anormale legata al dolore neuropatico nelle persone con SCI. descriptionByLocale.en:
Neuropathic pain is a major, debilitating secondary health condition after spinal cord injury (SCI). It likely involves abnormal brain–spinal interactions, including spinal hyperexcitability and altered pain modulation in the brain, but evidence in humans is still missing due to the lack of imaging protocols to measure spinal cord activity.

In this multicentre study (Swiss Paraplegic Research / Balgrist University Hospital), we will investigate neuropathic pain in SCI using brain and spinal cord fMRI. After setting up and validating a novel lumbosacral cord fMRI protocol across the two centres, we will assess spinal sensitisation and abnormal brain activity linked to neuropathic pain in individuals with SCI. As part of the PhD thesis, the student is expected to take an active role in all the aspects of the project, including study conceptualization and design, preparation of the ethical application, data collection and analysis, and publication of the results. Aufgaben: • Contribution to study conceptualization and design • Writing and submission of study documents for approval by ethics committees or authorities • Enrolment of study participants, data collection, analysis and interpretation • Writing and submission of publications in high impact, peer-reviewed journals • Presentation of research findings at national and international conferences Anforderungen: • Master degree in neuroscience, psychology, biology, biomedical engineering or similar, acceptable for matriculation at a Swiss University (Bologna compatible) • Interest in neuroimaging methods, with particular focus on functional MRI • Knowledge in Matlab and/or RStudio • Willingness to work with patients in clinical settings • Proactive, good communication skills and attitude to team-work • Excellent knowledge in both German and English, mother tongue German is preferred • Willingness to travel regularly between Zurich and Nottwil (Lucerne) Wir bieten: You can expect attractive employment conditions as well as numerous other advantages. The mission of SPF is sustainably improving the situation of people with spinal cord injury (SCI) through interdisciplinary, clinical and Community-based research on a national and international level. Specific areas of its comprehensive research include functioning, mobility, social integration, equality of opportunity, self-determination, quality of life, health services provision as well as epidemiology and statistical methods. SPF is an university research institution recognized and promoted by the Swiss federal government and the cantons and an active link to academic and industrial research and development at the national and international levels.

Es handelt sich wahrscheinlich um abnorme Gehirn-Rückenmark-Interaktionen, einschließlich der spinalen Hypererregbarkeit und veränderter Schmerzmodulation im Gehirn, aber Beweise beim Menschen fehlen immer noch aufgrund des Mangels an Bildgebungsprotokollen zur Messung der Rückenmarksaktivität. In dieser multizentrischen Studie (Swiss Paraplegic Research / Balgrist University Hospital) werden wir neuropathische Schmerzen bei SCI mithilfe von Gehirn- und Rückenmark-fMRI untersuchen. Nach der Einrichtung und Validierung eines neuartigen lumbosakralen fMRI-Protokolls in den beiden Zentren werden wir die Wirbelsäulensensibilisierung und abnormale Gehirnaktivität im Zusammenhang mit neuropathischen Schmerzen bei Personen mit SCI bewerten. Im Rahmen der Doktorarbeit wird erwartet, dass der Student eine aktive Rolle in allen Aspekten des Projekts einnimmt, einschließlich Studienkonzeption und -design, Vorbereitung der ethischen Anwendung, Datensammlung und -analyse und Veröffentlichung der Ergebnisse. Aufgaben:
• Beitrag zum Studium Konzeptualisierung und Design
• Verfassen und Einreichen von Studiendokumenten zur Genehmigung durch Ethikkommissionen oder Behörden
• Einschreibung der Studienteilnehmer, Datenerhebung, Analyse und Interpretation
• Verfassen und Einreichen von Publikationen in einflussreichen, von Experten begutachteten Zeitschriften
• Präsentation der Forschungsergebnisse auf nationalen und internationalen Konferenzen Anforderungen:
• Master-Abschluss in Neurowissenschaften, Psychologie, Biologie, Biomedizintechnik oder ähnlichem, akzeptabel für die Immatrikulation an einer Schweizer Universität (Bologna kompatibel)
• Interesse an Neuroimaging-Methoden, mit besonderem Fokus auf funktionelle MRT
• Kenntnisse in Matlab und/oder RStudio
• Bereitschaft, mit Patienten im klinischen Umfeld zu arbeiten
• Proaktive, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Einstellung zur Teamarbeit
• Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Muttersprache Deutsch wird bevorzugt
• Bereitschaft, regelmäßig zwischen Zürich und Nottwil (Luzern) zu reisen Wir bieten: Sie können attraktive Beschäftigungsbedingungen sowie zahlreiche andere Vorteile erwarten. Freuen Sie sich auf sinnvolles Arbeiten in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld, flexible Arbeitszeiten und verschiedene Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Die Mission von SPF ist es, die Situation von Menschen mit Rückenmarksverletzungen (SCI) durch interdisziplinäre, klinische und gemeinschaftsbasierte Forschung auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene nachhaltig zu verbessern. Spezifische Bereiche ihrer umfassenden Forschung umfassen Funktionsweise, Mobilität, soziale Integration, Chancengleichheit, Selbstbestimmung, Lebensqualität, Gesundheitsversorgung sowie Epidemiologie und statistische Methoden. La douleur neuropathique est une maladie secondaire grave et débilitante après une lésion de la moelle épinière (SCI). Il s'agit probablement d'interactions cérébrales et spinales anormales, y compris une hyperexcitabilité de la moelle épinière et une modulation de la douleur altérée dans le cerveau, mais les données chez l'homme sont toujours manquantes en raison de l'absence de protocoles d'imagerie pour mesurer l'activité de la moelle épinière.

Dans cette étude multicentrique (Swiss Paraplégic Research / Balgrist University Hospital), nous étudierons la douleur neuropathique dans le SCI en utilisant l'IRMf du cerveau et de la moelle épinière. Après la mise en place et la validation d'un nouveau protocole d'IRMf à cordon lombosacral dans les deux centres, nous évaluerons la sensibilisation de la colonne vertébrale et l'activité cérébrale anormale liée à la douleur neuropathique chez les personnes atteintes d'ICS. Dans le cadre de la thèse de doctorat, l'étudiant devrait jouer un rôle actif dans tous les aspects du projet, y compris la conceptualisation et la conception des études, la préparation de l'application éthique, la collecte et l'analyse des données et la publication des résultats. La mission du SPF consiste à améliorer durablement la situation des personnes atteintes de lésions de la moelle épinière (SCI) grâce à des recherches interdisciplinaires, cliniques et communautaires aux niveaux national et international. Ses recherches approfondies portent notamment sur le fonctionnement, la mobilité, l'intégration sociale, l'égalité des chances, l'autodétermination, la qualité de vie, la prestation de services de santé ainsi que l'épidémiologie et les méthodes statistiques. SPF est un établissement de recherche universitaire reconnu et promu par le gouvernement fédéral suisse et les cantons et un lien actif avec la recherche et le développement académiques et industriels aux niveaux national et international.
